05 / YOUR QUESTIONS

Before
we begin.

Good collaboration starts
with clarity.

Let’s discuss your needs ↗
How much does a project cost?

The price depends on the scope, features and integrations. After an initial conversation, we prepare a proposal covering deliverables, stages and terms. A standard price cannot replace an assessment of your needs.

How long does a project take?

A business website and a business application have different timelines. We agree on a schedule after defining the scope, taking content, approvals and technical constraints into account.

Can you take over an existing project?

Yes, after reviewing its technical condition, available documentation and access. This review helps determine whether to fix, improve or rebuild specific parts.

What happens after delivery?

Launch, documentation and onboarding are defined in the proposal. Corrective maintenance, updates and improvements can be covered by a tailored support arrangement.

Will I receive the source code and access credentials?

The terms for handing over code, access, rights and licences are set out in the contract. We address these points from the outset so you know what you will receive.

Do you work remotely and throughout Algeria?

Scoping, demos and follow-up can take place remotely. Communication arrangements and any travel are agreed together for each project.
